harrat-mujtaba:1-1.t: «سبحان الذي»: a substitute for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) (nāʾib mafʿūl muṭlaq), and the relative noun is muḍāf ilayhi. The genitive maṣdar (verbal noun) «لنريه» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «أسرى», and the clause «نريه» is the ṣila (relative clause) of the particle-relative [أن]. «هو» is tawkīd (emphasis) of the hāʾ, and the clause «إنه هو السميع» is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:2-2.t: The clause «وآتينا» is conjoined to the preceding clause of glorification. «هدى» is a second object, and the preposition «لبني» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a naʿt (adjective) of «هدى». The maṣdar (verbal noun) «ألا تتخذوا» is accusative by removal of the preposition: the lām. The preposition «من دوني» is attached to a ḥāl (circumstantial) of «وكيلا».

harrat-mujtaba:3-3.t: «ذرية»: the postponed first object of {تَتَّخِذُوا}; «مَن» is a relative noun, muḍāf ilayhi. {وَكِيلا} is then among the words that occur singular in form while what is meant by them is plural, i.e.: do not take the offspring of those We carried with Noah as guardians (wukalāʾ). The clause «إنه كان عبدا» is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:4-4.t: (إلى بني إسرائيل في الكتاب) [Translator's note: phrase discussed] The two preposition and its genitive nouns are attached to (mutaʿalliq) «قضينا», and «قضى» is made to contain the sense of أوحى (to reveal). His words «لتفسدن»: the lām occurs in the apodosis of the oath; an imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn, which was dropped because of the succession of like letters; the wāw, dropped because of the meeting of two quiescent letters, is the fāʿil (agent); and the nūn is for emphasis. «مرتين» is a substitute for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object). His words «ولتعلُنَّ» are like «لتفسدن».

harrat-mujtaba:5-5.t: The conditional clause is conjoined to the preceding apodosis of the oath. The preposition «لنا» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a naʿt (adjective) of «عبادا»; «أُولي» is a naʿt of «عبادا»; and the clause «وكان وعدا مفعولا» is parenthetical between the two conjoined elements.

harrat-mujtaba:6-6.t: The preposition «عليهم» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) of «الكرَّة»; «أكثر» is a second object; «نفيرا» is a tamyīz (specification).

harrat-mujtaba:7-7.t: His words «فلها»: the fāʾ is connective (rābiṭa), and the preposition and its genitive noun is attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), i.e.: فإساءتكم لها (then your evil-doing is against it). The second conditional clause is conjoined to the first. The lām in «ليسوءوا» is causal, and the genitive interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) is attached to the omitted apodosis of «إذا», its implied form being: بعثنا عليكم عبادًا (We sent against you servants). The kāf in «كما» is a substitute for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), and «ما» is maṣdariyya, i.e.: an entering like their entering. His words «ما عَلوا»: a relative noun, mafʿūl bihi (direct object), i.e.: to destroy that which they overcame.

harrat-mujtaba:8-8.t: The maṣdar (verbal noun) «أن يرحمكم» is the khabar (predicate) of «عسى». The conditional clause is conjoined to the resumptive «عسى ربكم». «حصيرا» is a second object.

harrat-mujtaba:9-9.t: The clause «هي أقوم» is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, and the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) «أن لهم أجرا» is accusative by removal of the preposition, the bāʾ.

harrat-mujtaba:10-10.t: (وأن الذين لا يؤمنون بالآخرة) [Translator's note: phrase discussed] The interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) is conjoined to the preceding maṣdar. The clause «أعتدنا» is the khabar (predicate) of أن.

harrat-mujtaba:11-11.t: The wāw was dropped from «يدعو» in the script, in keeping with its dropping in pronunciation because of the meeting of two quiescent letters. «دعاءه» is a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object); the preposition «بالخير» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the maṣdar (verbal noun) (دعاءه). The clause «وكان الإنسان عجولا» is conjoined to the clause «ويدعو الإنسان».

harrat-mujtaba:12-12.t: «آيتين» is a second object, and so is «مبصرة». The maṣdar (verbal noun) «لتبتغوا» is genitive, attached to (mutaʿalliq) «جعلنا»; the preposition «من ربكم» is attached to a naʿt (adjective) of «فضلا». His words «وكل شيء»: the mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of an omitted verb explained by what follows, and the clause «فصَّلْناه» is explicative.

harrat-mujtaba:13-13.t: His words «وكل»: the mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of an omitted verb explained by what follows. The preposition «في عنقه» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) of «طائره». The implied clause «ألزمنا» is conjoined to the clause «فصَّلنا», and the clause «ألزمناه» is explicative. The clause «يلقاه» is a naʿt (adjective) of «كتابا». The clause «نُخْرِج» is conjoined to the clause «ألزمنا كل».

harrat-mujtaba:14-14.t: «كفى بنفسك»: a past verb and its fāʿil (agent), and the bāʾ is redundant (zāʾida). «اليوم» is an adverb attached to (mutaʿalliq) «كفى». The preposition «عليك» is attached to «حسيبا», and «حسيبا» is a tamyīz (specification). «كفى» was not made feminine because its fāʿil is figuratively feminine.

harrat-mujtaba:15-15.t: «من اهتدى»: a conditional noun, mubtadaʾ (subject), and the clause «فإنما يهتدي لنفسه» is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ). «وِزْرَ» is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object). The clause «وما كنا» is resumptive, and the clause «ولا تزر» is conjoined to the clause «مَنْ اهتدى». The genitive interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) (حتى أن نبعث) is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «معذِّبين». The clause «نبعث» is the ṣila (relative clause) of the particle-relative.

harrat-mujtaba:16-16.t: The conditional clause is conjoined to the clause {وَمَا كُنَّا}. The maṣdar (verbal noun) «أن نهلك» is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and the clause «أمرنا» is the apodosis of a non-jussive condition, with no grammatical position.

harrat-mujtaba:17-17.t: His words «وكم أهلكنا»: the wāw is resumptive; «كم» is the declarative (khabariyya) kam, a fronted mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the preposition «من القرون» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a naʿt (adjective) of «كم»; the preposition «من بعد» is attached to «أهلكنا». The clause «وكفى بربك» is resumptive, and the bāʾ is redundant (zāʾida) in the fāʿil (agent) of «كفى». «خبيرا بصيرا» are two tamyīzes (specifications).

harrat-mujtaba:18-18.t: «مَنْ»: conditional, mubtadaʾ (subject). The two preposition and its genitive nouns «له فيها» are attached to (mutaʿalliq) «عجَّلْنا», and the preposition «لمن» is a badal (substitute) of «له», part for whole. The clause «يصلاها» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the pronoun in «له». His words «مذموما مدحورا»: two ḥāls of the hāʾ in «يصلاها».

harrat-mujtaba:19-19.t: «سعيَها»: a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object). The clause «وهو مؤمن» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the fāʿil (agent) of «سعى». The clause «فأولئك كان سعيهم مشكورا» is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ). The clause «كان سعيهم مشكورا» is the khabar (predicate) of «أولئك».

harrat-mujtaba:20-20.t: «كُلا»: a fronted mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of «نمد»; «هؤلاء» is a badal (substitute) of «كلا», and the second «هؤلاء» is conjoined to the first. The preposition «من عطاء» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «نمدّ». The clause «وما كان عطاء» is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:21-21.t: The clause «فضَّلنا» is the object of the looking, which contains the sense of knowing and is suspended (muʿallaq) by the interrogative. «كيف» is an interrogative noun, ḥāl (circumstantial). The clause «وللآخرة أكبر» is resumptive; the lām is for emphasis, and «درجات» is a tamyīz (specification).

harrat-mujtaba:22-22.t: «مع»: an adverb of place for accompaniment, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the second object of «جعل». His words «فتقعد»: the fāʾ is causal; an imperfect verb, accusative by an implied أن; and the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) is conjoined to a maṣdar extracted from the preceding speech, i.e.: لا يكن منك جَعْلٌ فقعودٌ (let there not be from you a setting up and then a sitting). His words «مذموما مخذولا»: two ḥāls (circumstantials) of the pronoun "you" (أنت).

harrat-mujtaba:23-23.t: The maṣdar (verbal noun) «ألا تعبدوا» is accusative by removal of the preposition, the bāʾ. «إياه» is a detached accusative pronoun, mafʿūl bihi (direct object). His words «وبالوالدين إحسانا»: the wāw is a conjunction; the preposition and its genitive noun is attached to (mutaʿalliq) an implied «أحسنوا»; «إحسانا» is a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object); and the implied clause «أحسنوا» is conjoined to the clause «تعبدوا». His words «إمَّا»: composed of the conditional «إنْ» and the redundant «ما»; the imperfect verb is indeclinable (mabnī) on fatḥa, in the position of the jussive, and the nūn is for emphasis. «الكِبَر» is the mafʿūl bihi; «أحدهما» is a postponed fāʿil (agent). «أو كلاهما»: «أو» is a conjunction; «كلاهما» is a conjoined noun, nominative with the alif because it is assimilated to the dual. His words «أف»: a verbal noun with the sense of an imperfect, meaning أتضجَّر (I am vexed), and the fāʿil is the pronoun "I" (أنا).

harrat-mujtaba:24-24.t: The preposition «من الرحمة» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «اخفض». «كما»: the kāf is a substitute for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), and «ما» is maṣdariyya; [ربَّياني is] a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on fatḥa because it is joined to the alif of the dual; the alif is the fāʿil (agent), the nūn is for protection (wiqāya), and the yāʾ is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object). «صغيرا» is a ḥāl (circumstantial), and the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) is muḍāf ilayhi, i.e.: have mercy on them with a mercy like their raising of me. The clause «ربَّياني» is the ṣila (relative clause) of the particle-relative.

harrat-mujtaba:25-25.t: «بما»: the bāʾ is a preposition; «ما» is a relative noun in the position of the genitive, attached to (mutaʿalliq) «أعلم». The clause «ربكم أعلم» is parenthetical between the two conjoined elements, and the clause «إن تكونوا» is resumptive within the scope of the parenthesis. The preposition «للأوابين» is attached to «غفورا».

harrat-mujtaba:26-26.t: His words «وآتِ»: the wāw is a conjunction; an imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the dropping of the weak letter; its two objects are ذا and حقه. The clause is conjoined to the clause «قل».

harrat-mujtaba:27-27.t: The clause «إن المبذرين كانوا» is parenthetical between the two conjoined elements, and the clause «وكان الشيطان كفورا» is conjoined to the clause «إن المبذرين كانوا». The preposition «لربه» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the khabar (predicate).

harrat-mujtaba:28-28.t: «وإما»: the wāw is a conjunction, «إنْ» is conditional and «ما» is redundant (zāʾida); an imperfect verb indeclinable (mabnī) on fatḥa, and the nūn is for emphasis. The fāʿil (agent) is the pronoun "you" (أنت). «ابتغاء» is a mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose); the preposition «من ربك» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a naʿt (adjective) of «رحمة»; the clause «ترجوها» is a second naʿt of «رحمة».

harrat-mujtaba:29-29.t: «مغلولة»: a second object; the preposition «إلى عنقك» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «مغلولة»; «كل» is a substitute for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object). His words «فتقعد»: the fāʾ is causal, and the verb is accusative by an implied أن; the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) is conjoined to a maṣdar extracted from the preceding speech, i.e.: لا يكن بَسْط فقعود (let there not be an extending and then a sitting). «ملوما محسورا» are two ḥāls (circumstantials) of the pronoun in «تقعد».

harrat-mujtaba:30-30.t: The clause «إن ربك يبسط» is parenthetical between the two conjoined elements, and the clause «إنه كان» is resumptive within the scope of the parenthesis. The preposition «بعباده» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «خبيرا».

harrat-mujtaba:31-31.t: «خشية»: a mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose). «وإياكم» is a detached pronoun conjoined to the hāʾ in «يرزقهم». The clause «نحن نرزقهم» is resumptive, and so is the clause «إنَّ قتلهم كان».

harrat-mujtaba:32-32.t: The clause «إنه كان» is resumptive, and the clause «وساء سبيلا» is conjoined to the clause «إنه كان». «سبيلا» is a tamyīz (specification), and the one specified for blame is omitted, its implied form being هو, i.e.: الزنى (fornication).

harrat-mujtaba:33-33.t: «التي»: a naʿt (adjective) of النفس; «إلا» is for restriction (ḥaṣr); the preposition «بالحق» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the wāw in «تقتلوا». The clause «ومن قتل» is resumptive; «من» is conditional, mubtadaʾ (subject); «مظلوما» is a ḥāl of the pronoun in «قتل». The clause «فلا يسرف» is conjoined to the clause «جعلنا»; conjoining a command-type (inshāʾ) clause to a declarative (khabar) one is permitted. The clause «إنه كان» is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:34-34.t: The preposition «بالتي» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the wāw in «تقربوا»; «أشدَّه» is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object). The clause «وأوفوا» is conjoined to the clause «لا تقربوا», and the clause «إن العهد كان مسؤولا» is parenthetical between the two conjoined elements.

harrat-mujtaba:35-35.t: The conditional clause with its implied apodosis is resumptive; the clause «كِلْتم» is muḍāf ilayhi; the clause «ذلك خير» is parenthetical; «تأويلا» is a tamyīz (specification).

harrat-mujtaba:36-36.t: His words «ولا تقف»: the wāw is a conjunction, «لا» is prohibitive, and an imperfect verb jussive (majzūm) by the dropping of the weak letter. «ما» is a relative noun, mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the preposition «لك» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the khabar (predicate) of ليس; the preposition «به» is attached to a ḥāl (circumstantial) of «علم»; «علم» is the noun of ليس. The clause «كل أولئك كان» is the khabar of «إن»; «أولئك» is muḍāf ilayhi; and the clause «إن السمع ... » is parenthetical.

harrat-mujtaba:37-37.t: «مرحا»: a maṣdar (verbal noun) in the place of a ḥāl (circumstantial); «طولا» is a tamyīz (specification).

harrat-mujtaba:39-39.t: (ذلك مما أوحى إليك ربك من الحكمة) [Translator's note: phrase discussed] The demonstrative points to the obligations mentioned before. The preposition «من الحكمة» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the implied referent pronoun, i.e.: أوحاه كائنا من الحكمة (He revealed it, being of wisdom). «مع» is an adverb of place attached to the second object of «جعل». The fāʾ in «فتُلقى» is causal; an imperfect passive verb, accusative by an implied أَنْ; and the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) is conjoined to a maṣdar extracted from the preceding speech, i.e.: لا يكن جَعْل فإلقاء (let there not be a setting up and then a casting).

harrat-mujtaba:40-40.t: The clause «أفأصفاكم» is resumptive; the preposition «من الملائكة» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the second object.

harrat-mujtaba:41-41.t: The clause «ولقد صرَّفنا» is resumptive. The clause «وما يزيدهم» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the pronoun in «صَرَّفنا». The fāʿil (agent) of «يزيدهم» is a pronoun whose implied form is هو, i.e.: the varying [of the discourse]. «نفورا» is a second object.

harrat-mujtaba:42-42.t: The conditional clause is what is said (maqūl al-qawl). «معه» is an adverb attached to (mutaʿalliq) the khabar (predicate). The kāf in «كما» is a substitute for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), and «ما» is maṣdariyya, i.e.: if there were gods with Him, a being like their saying. «سبيلا» is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object).

harrat-mujtaba:43-43.t: The preposition «عمَّا» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «تعالى»; it is composed of the preposition «عن» and the relative «ما». The clause «وتعالى» is conjoined to the governor of the maṣdar (verbal noun), i.e.: تنزه وتعالى (He is far removed and exalted).

harrat-mujtaba:44-44.t: «مَنْ»: a relative noun conjoined to السماوات; the preposition «فيهن» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the implied ṣila (relative clause). His words «وإن من شيء إلا يسبح»: the wāw is a conjunction; «شيء» is the mubtadaʾ (subject); «من» is redundant (zāʾida); «إلا» is for restriction (ḥaṣr); and the clause «يسبح» is the khabar (predicate). The clause «وإن من شيء إلا يسبح» is conjoined to the resumptive «تسبح له السماوات». The preposition «بحمده» is attached to a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the fāʿil (agent) of «يسبح», and «إلا» is for restriction. The clause «ولكن لا تفقهون» is conjoined to the clause «إنْ من شيء ... ».

harrat-mujtaba:45-45.t: The conditional clause is resumptive; the clause «قرأت» is muḍāf ilayhi. «بينك» is an adverb of place attached to (mutaʿalliq) the second object of «جعلنا».

harrat-mujtaba:46-46.t: «أكنَّة»: the object of «جعل», and the maṣdar (verbal noun) «أن يفقهوه» is a mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose), i.e.: كراهة (out of dislike that). «وفي آذانهم وقرا»: the preposition and its genitive noun is conjoined to «على قلوبهم», and «وقرًا» is conjoined to «أكنَّة». The conditional clause is conjoined to the clause {وَإِذَا قَرَأْتَ الْقُرْآنَ}. «وحده»: a ḥāl (circumstantial) of «ربك» in the sense of منفردا (alone); it is thus definite in form with the force of an indefinite. «نفورا» is a maṣdar in the place of a ḥāl of the fāʿil (agent) of «ولَّوا», and the clause «ولَّوا» is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ).

harrat-mujtaba:47-47.t: The preposition «بما» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «أعلم»; whatever belongs to the domain of knowledge and ignorance among elatives (afʿal al-tafḍīl) is made transitive with the bāʾ, as in: أنت أعلم به (you know it better). The preposition «به» is attached to the imperfect verb, i.e.: they listen with their outward hearing. The clause «يستمعون» is muḍāf ilayhi; «إذ يستمعون» is an adverb attached to «أعلم». His words «وإذ هم نجوى»: the wāw is a conjunction; «إذ» is an adverb conjoined to the «إذ» before it and attached to what that is attached to; «نجوى» is a maṣdar (verbal noun), as a case of applying the maṣdar to the person by way of intensification; and the clause «هم نجوى» is muḍāf ilayhi. «إذ يقول»: the adverb is a badal (substitute) of «إذ هم». «إن تتبعون»: «إن» is negating, «إلا» is for restriction (ḥaṣr), and the clause is what is said (maqūl al-qawl).

harrat-mujtaba:48-48.t: «كيف»: an interrogative noun, ḥāl (circumstantial); and the clause «ضربوا» is the object of the looking, which is suspended (muʿallaq) by the interrogative and contains the sense of knowing.

harrat-mujtaba:49-49.t: «إذا»: a conditional adverb attached to (mutaʿalliq) the sense of the implied apodosis, i.e.: أنُبعث إذا (shall we be raised when…). «مبعوثون» does not govern «إذا», because what comes after «إنَّ» does not govern what precedes it, and likewise what comes after the interrogative does not govern what precedes it, and both are combined here. «خلقا» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the pronoun in «مبعوثون», and the clause «أإنا لمبعوثون» is explicative of the implied apodosis.

harrat-mujtaba:51-51.t: The preposition «ممَّا» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a naʿt (adjective) of خلقا. «من» is an interrogative noun, mubtadaʾ (subject), and the clause «يعيدنا» is the khabar (predicate). «أول» is an adverb of time attached to «فطركم». The clause «فسينغضون» is resumptive. «متى» is an interrogative noun, an adverb of time attached to the khabar; «هو» is the mubtadaʾ; the maṣdar (verbal noun) «أن يكون» is the fāʿil (agent) of the complete «عسى», i.e.: عسى كونه قريبا (perhaps its being is near).

harrat-mujtaba:52-52.t: «يوم»: the object of an implied «اذكر» (remember), and the clause «اذكر» is resumptive. The clause «يدعوكم» is muḍāf ilayhi. The preposition «بحمده» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the fāʿil (agent) of «تستجيبون», by making it contain the sense of تُسَبِّحون (you glorify). The clause «فتستجيبون» is conjoined to the clause «يدعوكم». The clause «إن لبثتم» stands in place of the two objects of «ظنَّ», which is suspended (muʿallaq) by «إنْ»; «إن» is negating, «إلا» is for restriction (ḥaṣr), and «قليلا» is a substitute for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), i.e.: لبثا قليلا (a short stay).

harrat-mujtaba:53-53.t: The clause «وقل» is resumptive, and what is said (maqūl al-qawl) is implied, i.e.: say to them what you wish. «يقولوا» is jussive (majzūm), occurring as the apodosis of an implied condition, i.e.: إن تقل لهم يقولوا (if you tell them, they will say), for they comply. The clause «إن الشيطان كان» is resumptive, and the preposition «للإنسان» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «عدوا».

harrat-mujtaba:54-54.t: The preposition «بكم» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the khabar (predicate). The conditional clause is resumptive, and the clause «وما أرسلناك» is parenthetical. The preposition «عليهم» is attached to أرسلناك, and «وكيلا» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the kāf in «أرسلناك».

harrat-mujtaba:55-55.t: The preposition «في السماوات» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the implied ṣila (relative clause), and the clause «ولقد فَضَّلْنا» is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:56-56.t: The preposition «من دونه» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the relative noun, and the two objects of the claiming are omitted, i.e.: زعمتموهم آلهة (you claimed them to be gods). The clause «فلا يملكون» is conjoined to the clause «ادعوا»; the preposition «عنكم» is attached to the maṣdar (verbal noun) (كشف).

harrat-mujtaba:57-57.t: «الذين»: a badal (substitute) of the demonstrative, and the referent pronoun is omitted, i.e.: يدعونهم. The clause «يبتغون» is the khabar (predicate). His words «أيهم أقرب»: a relative noun, a badal of the wāw in «يبتغون»; it is indeclinable (mabnī) on ḍamma because it is in construct and the beginning of its ṣila (relative clause) has been omitted. «أقرب» is the khabar of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), i.e.: هو أقرب. That is: those whom they call upon — the one of them who is nearest to Him the Exalted seeks the means [of approach], so how about one below him? The clause «إن عذاب ربك كان محذورا» is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:58-58.t: His words «وإن من قرية»: the wāw is resumptive; «إن» is negating; «قرية» is the mubtadaʾ (subject), and «من» is redundant (zāʾida); «إلا» is for restriction (ḥaṣr); and the clause «نحن مهلكوها» is the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ. «قبل» is an adverb of time attached to (mutaʿalliq) «مهلكوها». «عذابا» is a substitute for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), its governor being the active participle. The clause «كان ذلك» is resumptive. The preposition «في الكتاب» is attached to «مَسْطورا».

harrat-mujtaba:59-59.t: The clause «وما منعنا» is conjoined to the clause «إن من قرية». The maṣdar (verbal noun) «أن نرسل» is the second mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of «منع»; «منع» is transitive by itself and with a preposition, as in: منعته النوم and من النوم (I kept him from sleep). The maṣdar «أن كذب» is the fāʿil (agent) of منع. The clause «وآتينا» is parenthetical. «مبصرة» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) of «الناقة». The clause «فظلموا» is conjoined to the clause «آتينا», and the clause «وما نرسل» is conjoined to the clause «منعنا». «تخويفا» is a mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose).

harrat-mujtaba:60-60.t: «وإذ»: the wāw is resumptive; «إذ» is an adverbial noun, the mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of an implied «اذكر» (remember). The implied clause «اذكر» is resumptive, and the clause «قلنا» is muḍāf ilayhi. «التي» is a naʿt (adjective) of الرؤيا. The preposition «للناس» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a naʿt of فتنة; «إلا» is for restriction (ḥaṣr); «الشجرة» is conjoined to «الرؤيا»; the preposition «في القرآن» is attached to «الملعونة»; «فتنة» is the second object of «جعل»; «طغيانا» is a second object. The clause «وما جعلنا» is conjoined to the implied resumptive one: اذكر; the clause «ونخوفهم» is conjoined to the implied resumptive one; and the clause «فما يزيدهم» is conjoined to the clause «نخوفهم».

harrat-mujtaba:61-61.t: «وإذ»: the wāw is a conjunction; «إذ» is an adverbial noun conjoined [to] the earlier «إذ». «طينا»: a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the referent pronoun of the relative noun, i.e.: خلقته طينا; the ḥāl is permitted to be a non-derived (jāmid) noun because it indicates origin, as though He said: متأصِّلا من طين (originating from clay).

harrat-mujtaba:62-62.t: His words «أرأيتك»: the hamza is interrogative, the tāʾ is the fāʿil (agent), and the kāf is for address; the meaning of the verb is أخبرني (tell me). The demonstrative is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object), «الذي» is a badal (substitute), and the second object is an implied interrogative clause, i.e.: أتكرّمه وأنا خير منه؟ (do You honour him while I am better than him?). His words «لئن أخرتن»: the lām prepares for the oath (muwaṭṭiʾa), «إن» is conditional; a past verb, the tāʾ is the fāʿil, the nūn is for protection (wiqāya), and the implied yāʾ is the mafʿūl bihi — it was dropped for lightening and the kasra sufficed in its place. «قليلا» is an accusative excepted (mustathnā). The clause «لأحتنكن» is the apodosis of the oath, and the apodosis of the condition (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, indicated by the apodosis of the oath.

harrat-mujtaba:63-63.t: The conditional clause is conjoined to the clause «اذهب». «مَنْ» is a conditional noun, mubtadaʾ (subject), and the clause «تبعك» is the khabar (predicate). «جزاء» is a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) whose governor is the maṣdar (verbal noun) before it.

harrat-mujtaba:64-64.t: The preposition «منهم» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) of «مَنْ», i.e.: كائنين منهم (being of them). The preposition «بصوتك» is attached to «استفزز». The preposition «بخيلك» is attached to a ḥāl of the fāʿil (agent) of «أجلب», i.e.: مصاحبا بخيلك (accompanied by your horsemen). The clause «وما يعدهم» is resumptive; «إلا» is for restriction (ḥaṣr); and «غرورا» is a substitute for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), i.e.: وعدًا غرورا (a deceptive promise).

harrat-mujtaba:65-65.t: The preposition «لك» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the khabar (predicate), and the preposition «عليهم» is attached to a ḥāl (circumstantial) of «سلطان». The clause «وكفى بربك» is resumptive, and the bāʾ is redundant (zāʾida) in the fāʿil (agent) of «كفى». «وكيلا» is a tamyīz (specification).

harrat-mujtaba:66-66.t: «الذي»: the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ (subject) «ربُّكم». The two preposition and its genitive nouns «لكم» and «في البحر» are attached to (mutaʿalliq) «يزجي», and so is the genitive maṣdar (verbal noun) «لتبتغوا»; two particles of the same wording may be attached to a single governor because the second is a badal (substitute) of the first. The clause «إنه كان» is resumptive, and the preposition «بكم» is attached to «رحيما».

harrat-mujtaba:67-67.t: The conditional clause is conjoined to the clause {رَبُّكُمُ الَّذِي يُزْجِي}. The clause «مسَّكم» is muḍāf ilayhi. «إياه» is a detached accusative pronoun, excepted (mustathnā), and the hāʾ is for the third person. The clause «فلمَّا نجاكم» is conjoined to the preceding conditional clause, and the clause «وكان الإنسان كفورا» is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:68-68.t: The clause «أفأمنتم» is resumptive. The maṣdar (verbal noun) «أن يخسف» is [accusative] by removal of the preposition «مِنْ». The preposition «بكم» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) of «جانب», and «جانب» is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object). The preposition «لكم» is attached to the implied second object, and «وكيلا» is the first object.

harrat-mujtaba:69-69.t: The clause «أم أمنتم» is resumptive, and the maṣdar (verbal noun) «أن يعيدكم» is [accusative] by removal of the preposition (من). «تارة» is a substitute for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object). The preposition «من الريح» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a naʿt (adjective) of «قاصفا». «ما» in His words «بما» is maṣdariyya, and the maṣdar is genitive, attached to «يغرقكم». The preposition «لكم» is attached to the second object of «وجد», «تبيعا» is the first object, the preposition «علينا» is attached to «تبيعا», and the preposition «به» is attached to «وجد».

harrat-mujtaba:70-70.t: The clause «ولقد كرَّمنا» is resumptive; the preposition «ممن» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a naʿt (adjective) of «كثير».

harrat-mujtaba:71-71.t: «يوم»: the mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of an implied «اذكر» (remember), and the clause «اذكر» is resumptive; the conditional clause is conjoined to the clause اذكر. The preposition «بإمامهم» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «ندعو». «من» is a conditional noun, mubtadaʾ (subject), and the clause «فأولئك يقرؤون» is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ). «فتيلا» is a substitute for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), i.e.: they will not be wronged by a wrong the size of a date-stone thread (fatīl).

harrat-mujtaba:72-72.t: The preposition «في هذه» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «أعمى»; «سبيلا» is a tamyīz (specification).

harrat-mujtaba:73-73.t: The clause «وإن كادوا» is resumptive. «إن» is lightened from the heavy [إنّ] and is inoperative; [كادوا is] an abrogating past verb with its noun, and the lām after it is the differentiating lām (al-fāriqa) that distinguishes the lightened [إن] from the negating one. The preposition «عن الذي» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «يفتنون» in the sense of يَصْرفون (to turn away), and the genitive maṣdar (verbal noun) «لتفتري» is attached to «يَفتنون». His words «وإذًا لاتخذوك»: the wāw is a conjunction; «إذًا» is an inoperative particle of answer; and the lām occurs in the apodosis of an implied condition, i.e.: لو فعلت ذلك لاتخذوك (had you done that, they would have taken you). The clause «اتخذوك» is the apodosis of an implied condition, and the conditional clause «ولو فعلت لاتخذوك» is conjoined to the resumptive «وإن كادوا».

harrat-mujtaba:74-74.t: His words «ولولا أن ثبتناك»: the wāw is a conjunction; «لولا» is a particle of non-occurrence due to occurrence; «أن» is maṣdariyya, followed by a past verb, its fāʿil (agent) and object; the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) is a mubtadaʾ (subject) whose khabar (predicate) is omitted, its implied form being: موجود, i.e.: ولولا تثبيتنا لك موجود (were it not that Our making you firm exists). «شيئا»: a substitute for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object). The clause «لقد كِدْتَ» is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ).

harrat-mujtaba:75-75.t: His words «إذًا لأذقناك»: a particle of answer, and the lām occurs in the apodosis of an implied condition, i.e.: لو فَعَلْتَ ذلك لأذقناك (had you done that, We would have made you taste). The preposition «لك» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the implied second object; the preposition «علينا» is attached to «نصيرا».

harrat-mujtaba:76-76.t: The clause «وإن كادوا» is conjoined to the clause «إن كادوا» in verse (73). «إن» is lightened and inoperative, and the lām after it is the differentiating lām (al-fāriqa). The clause «يستفزّونك» is the khabar (predicate) of كاد. His words «وإذًا»: the wāw is a conjunction; «إذًا» is an inoperative particle of answer because it does not stand at the head [of its clause]. His words «خلافك»: an adverb of time attached to (mutaʿalliq) «يلبث». «قليلا» is a substitute for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), i.e.: لبثًا قليلا (a short stay). The implied clause «ولو فعلوا ذلك» is conjoined to the clause «إن كادوا», and the clause «لا يلبثون» is the apodosis of the implied condition, i.e.: لو أخرجوك لا يلبثون (had they expelled you, they would not remain).

harrat-mujtaba:77-77.t: «سنةَ»: a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) of an implied governor, i.e.: سَنَّ الله ذلك (Allah laid that down as a way); the clause «سَنَّ» is resumptive. The relative noun is muḍāf ilayhi; the adverb is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «أرسلنا»; and the preposition and its genitive noun is attached to a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the implied object of «أرسلنا», i.e.: أرسلناه كائنا مِنْ رسلنا (We sent him, being of Our messengers). The preposition «لسنتنا» is attached to the second object of «تجد», and «تحويلا» is the first object.

harrat-mujtaba:78-78.t: (لدلوك الشمس إلى غسق الليل) [Translator's note: phrase discussed] The two preposition and its genitive nouns are attached to (mutaʿalliq) «أقم». His words «وقرآن»: a noun conjoined to «الصلاة».

harrat-mujtaba:79-79.t: His words «ومن الليل»: the wāw is a conjunction; the preposition «من الليل» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) an implied «اسهر» (stay awake), and the implied clause is conjoined to the clause {أَقِمِ}. His words «فتهجَّد»: the fāʾ is a conjunction, and the clause is conjoined to the implied «اسهر». The maṣdar (verbal noun) «أن يبعثك» is the fāʿil (agent) of عسى. «مقاما»: a ḥāl (circumstantial), i.e.: He raises you possessing a station. The clause «عسى أن يبعثك» is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:80-80.t: «ربِّ»: one addressed in the vocative, in construct, accusative with a fatḥa implied on the letter before the dropped first-person yāʾ. «مُدخَل» is a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object); the preposition «لي» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the implied second object; and «من لدنك» — [لدن is] an adverbial noun indeclinable (mabnī) on sukūn, attached to that same implied second object.

harrat-mujtaba:82-82.t: The clause «وننزل» is resumptive; «ما» is a relative noun, mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the preposition «للمؤمنين» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a naʿt (adjective) of «رحمة»; «خسارا» is the second object of «يزيد», and «إلا» is for restriction (ḥaṣr). The clause «ولا يزيد» is conjoined to the clause «ننزل».

harrat-mujtaba:83-83.t: The conditional clause is resumptive. The clause «أنعمنا» is in the position of the genitive as muḍāf ilayhi.

harrat-mujtaba:84-84.t: Beginning with the indefinite «كل» is permitted because it indicates generality, and its tanwīn is in compensation for a single word, i.e.: كل أحد (everyone). The clause «فربكم أعلم» is conjoined to the clause «كل يعمل»; the preposition «بمن» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) أعلم; «سبيلا» is a tamyīz (specification).

harrat-mujtaba:85-85.t: The clause «ويسألونك» is resumptive; the clause «وما أوتيتم» is conjoined to what is said (maqūl al-qawl); the preposition «من العلم» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb; «إلا» is for restriction (ḥaṣr); «قليلا» is the second object of «أوتيتم».

harrat-mujtaba:86-86.t: The clause «ولئن شئنا» is resumptive; the clause «لنذهبنَّ» is the apodosis of the oath, and the apodosis of the condition (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, indicated by the apodosis of the oath. The clause «لا تجد» is conjoined to the clause «نذهبن», and it is not emphasised with the nūn because it is negated. His words «لا تجد»: transitive to two objects, the first «وكيلا», and the second what «لك» is attached to (mutaʿalliq). The preposition «به» is attached to the verb, and the preposition «علينا» is attached to a ḥāl (circumstantial) of «وكيلا». The implied form is: ثم لا تجد به وكيلا علينا لك.

harrat-mujtaba:87-87.t: «إلا»: a particle of exception; «رحمة» is the excepted (mustathnā); the preposition and its genitive noun is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a naʿt (adjective) of «رحمة»; and the preposition «عليك» is attached to the khabar (predicate) «كبيرا».

harrat-mujtaba:88-88.t: The lām in «لئن» prepares for the oath (muwaṭṭiʾa). The clause «لا يأتون» is the apodosis of the oath, and the apodosis of the condition (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, indicated by the apodosis of the oath; it is not emphasised with the nūn because it is negated. The interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) «على أن يأتوا» is genitive by «على», attached to (mutaʿalliq) «اجتمعت». The clause «ولو كان بعضهم» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the wāw in «يأتون»; the wāw is circumstantial, conjoined to an implied ḥāl for the sake of comprehensiveness, i.e.: they will not produce its like in any state, even in this state.

harrat-mujtaba:89-89.t: The clause «ولقد صرَّفنا» is resumptive; the preposition «في هذا» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «صرَّفْنا»; the preposition «من كل» is attached to a naʿt (adjective) of the omitted object, i.e.: مثلا كائنا من كل مثل (an example, being of every example). The clause «فأبى» is conjoined to the clause «صرَّفنا»; «كفورا» is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and «إلا» is for restriction (ḥaṣr).

harrat-mujtaba:90-90.t: The preposition «من الأرض» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) of «ينبوعا».

harrat-mujtaba:91-91.t: The preposition «من نخيل» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a naʿt (adjective) of «جنة».

harrat-mujtaba:92-92.t: His words «كما زعمت»: the kāf is a substitute for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), and «ما» is maṣdariyya, i.e.: you cause [the sky] to fall, a causing to fall like your claim. «كسفًا» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) of «السماء»; «قبيلا» is a ḥāl of the Name of Majesty and the angels.

harrat-mujtaba:93-93.t: The preposition «من زخرف» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a naʿt (adjective) of «بيت»; the clause «ولن نؤمن» is conjoined to the clause «ترقى»; the clause «نقرؤه» is a naʿt of «كتابا»; and the genitive maṣdar (verbal noun) after «حتى» is attached to «نؤمن». His words «سبحان»: a substitute for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) of an implied governor, and [ربي is] muḍāf ilayhi. The clause «سبحان ربي» is what is said (maqūl al-qawl), and the clause «هل كنت إلا بشرا» is resumptive within the scope of the saying.

harrat-mujtaba:94-94.t: The maṣdar (verbal noun) «أن يؤمنوا» is the second object of «منع»; «إذ» is an adverb of time attached to (mutaʿalliq) «يؤمنوا»; the maṣdar «أن قالوا» is the fāʿil (agent) of «منع»; and the clause «أبعث الله» is what is said (maqūl al-qawl).

harrat-mujtaba:95-95.t: The preposition «في الأرض» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the khabar (predicate); the clause «يمشون» is a naʿt (adjective) of «ملائكة»; the preposition «من السماء» is attached to the verb.

harrat-mujtaba:96-96.t: The bāʾ is redundant (zāʾida) in the fāʿil (agent) of «كفى»; «شهيدا» is a tamyīz (specification); «بيني» is an adverb attached to (mutaʿalliq) «شهيدا». The clause «إنه كان» is resumptive, and «خبيرا بصيرا» are two khabars (predicates) of كان.

harrat-mujtaba:97-97.t: The clause «ومن يهد» is resumptive; «مَن» is a conditional noun, mafʿūl bihi (direct object); «المهتد» is a nominative khabar (predicate), with a ḍamma implied on the dropped yāʾ. The preposition «لهم» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the second object; the preposition «من دونه» is attached to a naʿt (adjective) of أولياء; the preposition «على وجوههم» is attached to a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the object of «نحشرهم»; and the clause «مأواهم جهنم» is a ḥāl of the object of «نحشرهم». His words «كلما»: كل is an adverb of time attached to «زدناهم», «ما» is a temporal maṣdariyya, and the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) is muḍāf ilayhi; the implied form is: زدناهم سعيرا كل وقت خبوِّها (We increase them in blaze every time it abates). The clause «زدناهم» is a ḥāl of «جهنم».

harrat-mujtaba:98-98.t: «ذلك جزاؤهم»: mubtadaʾ (subject) and khabar (predicate); the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) «بأنهم كفروا» is genitive, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the maṣdar (جزاء). «إذا» is a conditional adverb attached to the content of the apodosis, its implied form being نبعث (we are raised); «خَلْقا» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the pronoun in «مبعوثون»; and the clause «أإنا لمبعوثون» is explicative of the implied apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ).

harrat-mujtaba:99-99.t: The interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) «أن الله» stands in place of the two objects of رأى, and the interpreted maṣdar «أن يخلق» is genitive, attached to (mutaʿalliq) «قادر». The clause «وجعل» is conjoined to the clause «أولم يروا», because it has the force of: قد رأوا (they have indeed seen). The clause «لا ريب فيه» is a naʿt (adjective) of «أجلا».

harrat-mujtaba:100-100.t: «أنتم»: the fāʿil (agent) of an omitted verb explained by what follows; it is not a mubtadaʾ (subject), because «لو» is restricted to verbal clauses. The clause «تملكون» is explicative of the implied [verb], and the clause «أمسكتم» is the apodosis of لو. «إذًا» is a particle of answer. The clause «وكان الإنسان قتورا» is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:101-101.t: «بينات»: a naʿt (adjective) of «آيات». The clause «فاسأل بني إسرائيل» is parenthetical. «إذ» is an adverb of time attached to (mutaʿalliq) «آتينا», and the fāʿil (agent) of «جاءهم» is «موسى». The clause «فقال له فرعون» is conjoined to the clause «آتينا»; the clause «يا موسى» is parenthetical; and the lām in «لأظنك» is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa).

harrat-mujtaba:102-102.t: «ما» is negating; «هؤلاء» is a fronted mafʿūl bihi (direct object); «إلا» is for restriction (ḥaṣr); «ربُّ» is a postponed fāʿil (agent); «بصائر» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) of «هؤلاء»; and the vocative clause «يا فرعون» is parenthetical.

harrat-mujtaba:103-103.t: (فأراد أن يستفزهم) [Translator's note: phrase discussed] The interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) is the object of «أراد». «مَن» is a relative noun conjoined to the hāʾ; «معه» is an adverb attached to (mutaʿalliq) the ṣila (relative clause); «جميعا» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the hāʾ and of «مَن».

harrat-mujtaba:104-104.t: The conditional clause is conjoined to the clause «اسكنوا». «لفيفا»: a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the kāf in «بكم».

harrat-mujtaba:105-105.t: His words «وبالحق»: the wāw is resumptive, and the preposition and its genitive noun is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the hāʾ in «أنزلناه», and so is what follows it. «مبشِّرًا» is a ḥāl of the kāf.

harrat-mujtaba:106-106.t: His words «وقرآنا»: the wāw is a conjunction, and «قرآنا» is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of an omitted verb explained by what follows. The clause «فرقنا» is conjoined to the clause {أَنْزَلْنَاهُ}, and the clause «فرقناه» is explicative. The interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) «لتقرأه» is genitive, attached to (mutaʿalliq) «فرقناه», and the second preposition and its genitive noun «على مكث» is attached to a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the fāʿil (agent) of «تقرأ».

harrat-mujtaba:107-107.t: The preposition «من قبله» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «أوتوا»; the conditional clause is the khabar (predicate) of «إن»; «سُجَّدا» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the wāw in «يخرون».

harrat-mujtaba:108-108.t: «سبحان»: a substitute for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object). «إن» is lightened and inoperative, and the lām after it is the differentiating lām (al-fāriqa). The clause «إن كان» is resumptive within the scope of the saying.

harrat-mujtaba:109-109.t: The clause «يبكون» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the fāʿil (agent) of «يخرُّون»; «خشوعا» is the second object of «يزيدهم».

harrat-mujtaba:110-110.t: His words «أيًّا ما»: a conditional noun, a fronted mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and «ما» is redundant (zāʾida). «تَدْعوا» is an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by the dropping of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent). The fāʾ is connective (rābiṭa) for the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ).

harrat-mujtaba:111-111.t: The preposition «في الملك» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «شريك»; the preposition «من الذل» is attached to «ولي»; and the clause «ولم يكن» is conjoined to the ṣila (relative clause).
